game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Druid Grove, the druids' grove: the forest ranger must hold off wasp swarms while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the waterfall gate.
theme: Mystic Forest – Druid Grove: the druids' grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Druid Grove, repeat each round: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the waterfall gate. Then check pattern_rows and advance.
player_objective: Protect the waterfall gate from wasp swarms in Druid Grove: keep pattern_rows above zero until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Pattern Painter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 5, Level 7, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
